question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Break the ice

options.text: Ill-feeling carried by a person over a period of time
To say or do something that makes people feel more relaxed, especially at the beginning of a meeting, party

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Break the ice"** means to say or do something that makes people feel more relaxed, especially at the beginning of a meeting, party, etc. (बातचीत की शुरुआत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **He told a joke to break the ice at the start of the meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Break the ice"** is often used in social or business situations to ease tension or awkwardness among people.
 
 
• **Example: **The host's warm smile and friendly greeting helped to break the ice with the new guests.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom "Break the ice" is best explained by **Option 4**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Nervousness before a performance **(प्रदर्शन से पहले घबराहट): The feeling of anxiety or tension before performing in front of an audience.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt a lot of nervousness before her first stage performance.
 
 
 
• **Ill-feeling carried by a person over a period of time **(लंबे समय तक व्यक्ति द्वारा धारण की गई बुरी भावना): Sustained resentment or bitterness.
 
 
• **Example: **He carried an ill-feeling toward his colleague for years after the incident.
 
 
 
• **Respect for someone's achievements **(किसी की उपलब्धियों के लिए सम्मान): Appreciation or admiration for someone's accomplishments.
 
 
• **Example: **We all have great respect for her remarkable achievements in the field of science.
